messages:
daphne: Heads-up — we need to provision an embargoed per-tenant flag for AcmeCorp (contracted customer). Legal still has final sign-off but we want a preflight so flips are smooth. Flag key: `tenant_access_toggle_v2`. Primary asks: allowlist + contract metadata + VIP handling + telemetry & kill-switch. Plan: canary scoped to AcmeCorp org (0.5%) -> 10% -> full; abort if latency or errors regress. Who can flip prod? Also PR #4821 needs one more review. @alex @sam :eyes:

alex: I can take PR review today. Ops note: two ways to flip — UI in feature-service or CLI. Example CLI for allowlist/one-off:```bash
ffctl set --key tenant_access_toggle_v2 --env prod --allowlist acme-corp --meta contract_id=ACME-2026-042
```
We should also stamp the flag metadata with contract_id and vip=true if entitlement specifies VIP bypass. :+1:

sam: Ops guardrails — only infra-admin or oncall may flip in prod. Add a hard guard to prevent ramping past 10% without automated SLO gating. Recommend temporary fallback route: if per_tenant_latency_p95 > 400ms then route tenant to smaller-model fallback. @mina can you wire the SLO check?

mina: Yup, I'll add the gating to the rollout pipeline. Telemetry events: `tenant_flag_evaluation` and metric `per_tenant_latency_p95{tenant}`. Proposed alert: per_tenant_latency_p95{tenant="acme-corp"} > 400 for 5m -> abort ramp and notify #eng-oncall. I'll add a runbook section for rollback and smoke tests. Also, we'll redact PII in payloads before logging.

jen: Legal flag: keep this flag embargoed (not discoverable via public API) until contract is live. Ops action: ensure API entitlement check reads contract table before honoring allowlist. Redis notes: use prefix `tenant:flags:acme-corp` for TTLs. Also add a soft-disable API path so we can return 503+Retry-After for problematic tenants.

deploy-bot: deploy: Canary pipeline queued for `tenant_access_toggle_v2` -> scope: acme-corp -> 0.5% -> triggered by user `sam`. Build sha: abc123def. CI link: https://ci.internal/4782

alex: Quick sanity snippet for service-level gating in code (pseudocode):
```python
if flag_enabled(tenant):
    if latency_p95(tenant) > 400:
        route_to_fallback(tenant)  # small model path
    else:
        serve_normal(tenant)
```
Make sure the fallback path is monitored.

daphne: Thanks. Operational question: who will flip the first canary and when? Suggest today at 17:00 PST after PR merge and a 15m smoke window. @sam or @ops-oncall?

sam: I can flip at 17:00 PST and watch the dashboard for 30m. I'll post status in #eng-oncall and this thread. Need confirmation that runbook link is included and that alerts are wired.

mina: Runbook added: https://runbooks.internal/tenant-flags#acme-corp. It includes rollback steps (kill-switch -> remove allowlist entry -> disable flag entirely), alert definitions, and the smoke checklist (basic request/response, p95 latency, error-rate delta).

jen: Legal confirmed the wording; just added a note to the contract metadata requirement. Also asked for PII redaction before telemetry is stored — affirmed.

alex: PR #4821 merged (sha abc987) at 1767777850. I ran the unit + staging smoke. Ready for canary flip. :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy: Canary flip executed by @sam at 1767778000. Status: active -> `tenant_access_toggle_v2` scoped to acme-corp 0.5%. Monitoring: dashboard linked.

daphne: Great — thanks everyone. Please post the 30m and 1h checks here. If anything odd, run the kill-switch and mention @ops-oncall.

sam: Will do. Starting 30m watch now. :eyes:
